head: ### b721 — lane two, act one hundred and forty-eight, the table act under (R331): b720 at its weight and its corrigendum; the C2 table’s test halted at its rule, proved; the table over h = 3, 4, 5 and two predictions registered; the offset’s seventeen post hoc; the surgery carried; the frozen line quoted, drafted and rebuilt at its own pins; the federation pin closed
